creativity.reason: Level 0: the business description covers only precious metals mining and sales, with no creative activity.

community.reason: Level 2: sizeable employee development (IMPACT) plus specific external apprenticeships, internships and youth career education whose disclosed reach (over 40 placements) is limited, so the lower level is chosen when torn with 3.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: specific current internal inclusion practices (Coeur Heroes veteran hiring, domestic partner benefits, inclusion training) with limited or indirect reach figures, so the lower level is chosen when torn with 3.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 0: the filing fully describes the business and shows no service or program enabling founders or small businesses.

notes: The Item 7 targeted excerpt was empty, so all evidence is from Item 1. The Recruitment section also mentions partnership programs providing internships, scholarships and apprenticeships. These are treated as the same activity as E2 to avoid double counting, and the scholarships have no disclosed figures. Coeur Heroes (veterans) is tagged cross-cultural because the filing presents it under Inclusion; whether veterans count as an underrepresented group is borderline. The Lovelock medical clinic serves employees and dependents only, so it is not counted as community investment. Indigenous consultation is a permitting requirement and is not scored. The New Gold acquisition is planned (expected to close in first half of 2026) and does not affect scores. The Biodiversity Management Standard bullet appears twice in the Responsibility list.
